# Approval Center Integration

This package provides some UI components for your RN App to integrate with SeaTalk's Approval Center.

## namespace ApprovalRejectHandler

# method init

Init instance with SSO token and appClientId.

```javascript
init(props: IProp) => void Copy
```

**interface IProp**

|Name|Type|Mandatory|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|ssoToken|string|Yes|The login access token|
|appClientId|string|Yes|App ID of the current app|

# method requestApproveWithModal

![](data:image/png;base64,)

Show the approve confirm modal before sending the request to the Approval Center server. if the request is handled successfully, the Promise will resolve(), otherwise it will reject().

```javascript
requestApproveWithModal(data:ModalData) => Promise<ResolveResponse | RejectResponse> Copy
```

# method requestRejectWithModal

![](data:image/png;base64,)

Show the reject confirm modal before sending the request to the Approval Center server. if the request is handled successfully, the Promise will resolve(), otherwise it will reject().

```javascript
requestRejectWithModal(data:ModalData) => Promise<ResolveResponse | RejectResponse> Copy
```

**interface ModalData**

|Name|Type|Mandatory|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|itemId|string|Yes|The ID of the current approval item|
|title|string|Yes|The title of the modal|
|content|string|Yes|The content of the modal|
|okText|string|No|The text of the OK button|
|cancelText|string|No|The text of the Cancel button|
|inputConfig|IAlertTextInputConfig|No|The config of the input area|
|enableRequest|boolean|No|- The default value is True which means the request will be sent after the modal is confirmed (i.e., the user taps on the OK button) - Set it to False if you want to do something before sending the request by the app itself. This means no request will be sent after the user taps on the OK button|

**interface IAlertTextInputConfig**

|Name|Type|Description|
|---|---|---|
|placeholder|string|The placeholder text of the modal input box|
|prefilledText|string|- The prefilled text of the modal input box - prefilledText will rewrite placeholder if both are provided|
|maxInputLength|number|The default length is 200 characters|

**interface RejectResponse**

|Name|Type|Description|
|---|---|---|
|itemId|string|The ID of the current approval item|
|code|number|- Success: 0 - User clicks the cancel button: -2 - Lack of sessionId: -3|
|message|string|The description of the error|

**interface ResolveResponse**

|Name|Type|Description|
|---|---|---|
|itemId|string|The ID of the current approval item|
|code|number|- Success: 0 - User clicks the cancel button: -2 - Lack of sessionId: -3|
|message?|string|The description of the error|

# method requestApprove

Send an approve request to the Approval Center Server.

```javascript
requestApprove(itemId: string): Promise<ResolveResponse | RejectResponse> Copy
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Mandatory|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|itemId|string|Yes|The ID of the current approval item|

# method requestReject

Send a reject request to the Approval Center Server.

```javascript
requestReject(itemId: string, reason?: string): Promise<ResolveResponse | RejectResponse> Copy
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Mandatory|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|itemId|string|Yes|The ID of the current approval item|
|reason|string|Yes|The reason for rejecting the approval. The app needs to provide UI by itself for users to input the rejection reason|

# method requestSnooze

Send a snooze request to the Approval Center Server.

```javascript
requestSnooze(itemId: string): Promise<ResolveResponse | RejectResponse> Copy
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Mandatory|Description|
|---|---|---|---|
|itemId|string|Yes|The ID of the current approval item|

# Sample Code

```javascript
import ApproveRejectHandler from '@seatalk-rn/sdk-approve-reject-handler';


let ARH = new ApproveRejectHandler({
    ssoToken: 'token',
    appClientId: 'client_id',
});


// Click Reject Button
onReject() {
    ARH.requestRejectWithModal({
        itemId: "item_id",
        title: "Reject",
        content: `State the reason for rejecting Wen Xuanmo’s purchase application.`,
        okText: "Reject",
        cancelText: "Cancel",
        enableRequest: true,
        inputConfig: {
            placeholder: "Type Your Comment Here",
            prefilledText: "",
            maxInputLength: 100,
        },
    })
    .then((res) => {
        Alert.alert(JSON.stringify(res));
    })
    .catch((e) => {
        Alert.alert(e.message);
    });
}
// ... Copy
```
